title: Add signed-in floating + action button, clock-style viewer timer, Shorts branding, and ≤5s live list refresh

requirements.text: Add a signed-in-only floating “+” action button fixed to the bottom-right of the app that opens a small menu with three actions: “Upload Video”, “Upload Short”, and “Go Live”. Selecting an action must navigate the user to the correct existing page/flow to complete that action.

quotes: Build ot now and the plus can make u post video short and go live

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the floating + button is not visible.
When the user is authenticated, a circular floating + button is visible at bottom-right on all main routes (Home, Shorts, Live, Watch, Upload).
Clicking/tapping the + button opens a menu with exactly: Upload Video, Upload Short, Go Live.
Choosing Upload Video opens the existing upload flow pre-selected for long-form video.
Choosing Upload Short opens the existing upload flow pre-selected for short.
Choosing Go Live navigates to the existing Live page and opens the start-live flow (or focuses the existing Go Live action).
All user-facing labels are in English.

requirements.text: Update the Watch-page viewer timer UI to use a simple clock-style time-range selector (“from” time and “to” time) instead of raw minutes/seconds inputs. The timer must compute the countdown duration from the selected range and still pause the video automatically when it reaches zero.

quotes: the timer has a clock simple to set this time to this time

acceptanceCriteria: Viewer timer UI provides two clock-style inputs (From and To) for selecting times (e.g., using time pickers or hour/minute selectors).
Starting the timer computes a positive duration based on the selected range; if the range is invalid (e.g., To not after From), show an English validation message and do not start.
While active, the timer displays remaining time and provides a stop/cancel action.
When the timer reaches zero, the existing onTimerEnd behavior triggers and the video pauses as before.

requirements.text: Add a clear Shorts-specific branding element that says “Shorts” and visually indicates users can watch Shorts on the Shorts page header area (text-based; no new image required unless necessary).

quotes: And a logo that says shorts and u can watch shorts

acceptanceCriteria: The Shorts page header includes a prominent “Shorts” branding element (e.g., badge/lockup) in addition to the page title.
The branding element includes English text that indicates watching Shorts (e.g., subtitle/tagline) without changing app functionality.
No backend changes are required for this branding element.

requirements.text: Ensure the Live sessions browsing experience updates with a maximum refresh delay of 5 seconds by polling/refetching active live sessions at an interval of 5 seconds or less while the Live page is open.

quotes: and the delay is no longer then 5 sec

acceptanceCriteria: While the Live page is open, the list of active live sessions is automatically refreshed on an interval of ≤ 5 seconds.
Starting or ending a live session becomes visible to another user on the Live page within 5 seconds (assuming normal network conditions).
This refresh behavior does not require real-time sockets/websockets and uses the existing query/actor APIs.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui; compose them instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
Respect the existing “Go Live” feature as metadata-only; do not introduce unsupported external streaming infrastructure.
nonGoals: Implement real-time live video streaming with end-to-end latency ≤ 5 seconds (beyond metadata-only MVP).
Add guest upload and moderator approval workflows (not requested in the final user instruction).
Introduce third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
